transport.network_path: ordinary inherited supported HTTPS proxy and certificate trust
transport.access_failure: Preserve status/body/receipt and stop the affected route; no alternate endpoint, mirror or bypass

parsing: Bounded UTF8 JSON decoding only; no source execution or data URL resolution. Catalog must be a metadata mapping with the two named dictionary entries. Select documentary description, column definitions, advertised counts, reference/citation fields, source URLs and declared hash/size metadata; reject a response that instead supplies observation rows. Crossref projection is limited to DOI/title/author names/publisher/type/date/license/reference identity/abstract, withholding contact/affiliation strings.
retention: Retain exact bounded responses and request/status/timing/hash receipts locally; public report uses own paraphrase and selected metadata with source pins. Do not publish raw catalog/registry bodies by default.
exposure: Whole metadata response containers are machine read, including unrelated dataset descriptions and public commit/citation metadata. Researcher output is restricted to the two named entries and selected bibliographic fields. Counts, units, DOI numerals and incidental documentary descriptions are exposure; this is not a claim of globally untouched evidence. No raw observation data requested.
limits: Advertised row count is neither usable paired count nor independent-unit count. Source-new-to-project requires existing-report check; prior corpus/physical overlap remains unresolved. Archived DFT is labeled archived calculation, never experimental validation or new DFT. Missing conditions, units or observation-use terms remain explicit blockers to admission.
